defects.description: Primary 'Save Changes' button uses a bright cyan/blue (#00BFFF) that clashes with the dark navy/slate panel and purple accent used in the previous iteration. It looks like a default system color rather than a deliberate palette choice.
'Cancel' ghost button lacks visible border or sufficient contrast against the dark background, making it look unfinished or disabled.
Buttons are placed side-by-side at full width of the panel, which is acceptable but the gap between them feels slightly loose compared to internal field spacing.

regressions: Primary action button color changed from a cohesive purple to an out-of-place bright blue/cyan
Panel width appears slightly wider, changing the proportions of the card
top_fixes: Change 'Save Changes' button color back to purple (or a teal/blue that fits a dark-mode palette) to match the UI's accent color scheme
Add a subtle 1px border or increase text opacity on the 'Cancel' ghost button so it's clearly interactive
Tighten the gap between the two buttons slightly for better visual rhythm

manifest.prompt: Add a primary 'Save Changes' button and a ghost-style 'Cancel' button below the fields.
